audit_items.proof_trace: The guard at lines 132-135 checks `if (last_updated == now) { return }` before any state mutation. After a successful accrual, `borrow_index.set_value(new_value, now)` (line 148) stores `now` into `BorrowIndex.last_updated`; a subsequent call with the same `now` hits the guard immediately and returns with no side effects. All callers pass a constant `now` derived from the Sui `Clock` object, which is fixed per transaction.
